integrity: Exact symbolic polynomial equality plus independent localization checks; proof uses cited smoothness and additive cohomology theorem; no independent expert audit.
scientific_limitations: General complex pencils and rank-three odd biisotropic Grassmannians only, n>=3. This establishes ring nonisomorphism but does not determine the complete cohomology ring. An in-preparation manuscript on the smallest odd example could affect historical priority.
title: The rank-three odd biisotropic Grassmannians have different integral cohomology rings from their additive Grassmannian twins
